title: 网络安全 · 事件响应与数字取证 30 句
description: 覆盖事件定级、遏制、证据保全、数字取证、恢复、通报与复盘的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 目前的信息只支持把它定为可疑活动，还不足以确认发生了入侵。
items.en: The available information supports classifying this as suspicious activity, but it is not yet sufficient to confirm a compromise.
answers: The available information supports classifying this as suspicious activity, but it is not yet sufficient to confirm a compromise.
items.notes: support doing 表示证据支持某种判断；not yet sufficient to 限制结论强度。

items.zh: 事件级别取决于实际业务影响和潜在扩散范围，而不只取决于恶意软件类型。
items.en: The incident level depends on actual business impact and potential scope of propagation, not solely on the type of malware involved.
answers: The incident level depends on actual business impact and potential scope of propagation, not solely on the type of malware involved.
items.notes: depend on 指明评级依据；not solely on 避免单一指标判断。

items.zh: 在召集完整响应团队前，值班分析师应先验证告警是否涉及真实资产。
items.en: Before mobilising the full response team, the duty analyst should verify whether the alert relates to a genuine asset.
answers: Before mobilising the full response team, the duty analyst should verify whether the alert relates to a genuine asset.
items.notes: before doing 表示响应顺序；whether 引导验证内容。

items.zh: 如果受影响服务器承载关键支付流程，事件就需要立即升级给业务连续性负责人。
items.en: If the affected server supports a critical payment process, the incident must be escalated immediately to the business continuity lead.
answers: If the affected server supports a critical payment process, the incident must be escalated immediately to the business continuity lead.
items.notes: if 引出业务触发条件；escalate to 表示升级给某人。

items.zh: 即使技术影响尚未明确，涉及个人数据的迹象也可能触发法务评估。
items.en: Even where the technical impact remains unclear, indications of personal-data exposure may trigger a legal assessment.
answers: Even where the technical impact remains unclear, indications of personal-data exposure may trigger a legal assessment.
items.notes: even where 引导让步；may trigger 保留法律判断空间。

items.zh: 隔离主机可以阻止进一步通信，但也可能中断正在进行的取证采集。
items.en: Isolating the host may prevent further communication, but it could also interrupt forensic collection already in progress.
answers: Isolating the host may prevent further communication, but it could also interrupt forensic collection already in progress.
items.notes: 动名词短语作主语；may ... but could also 展示遏制权衡。

items.zh: 团队选择封禁恶意域名，而没有立即关闭整个代理服务，因为后者会影响所有远程员工。
items.en: The team blocked the malicious domain rather than shutting down the entire proxy service, which would have affected every remote employee.
answers: The team blocked the malicious domain rather than shutting down the entire proxy service, which would have affected every remote employee.
items.notes: rather than doing 表示处置选择；would have affected 说明反事实影响。

items.zh: 在重置高权限账户之前，必须确认攻击者是否建立了不依赖原密码的持久化。
items.en: Before resetting the privileged account, we must establish whether the attacker created persistence that does not rely on the original password.
answers: Before resetting the privileged account, we must establish whether the attacker created persistence that does not rely on the original password.
items.notes: establish whether 表示查明；that 引导定语从句限定持久化方式。

items.zh: 临时网络分段降低了横向移动风险，同时保留了恢复所需的管理通道。
items.en: Temporary network segmentation reduced the risk of lateral movement while preserving the management channel required for recovery.
answers: Temporary network segmentation reduced the risk of lateral movement while preserving the management channel required for recovery.
items.notes: while doing 表示两项目标同时实现；required 作后置定语。

items.zh: 除非威胁仍在主动扩散，否则不应在没有回退计划的情况下实施大范围变更。
items.en: Unless the threat is still spreading actively, broad changes should not be made without a rollback plan.
answers: Unless the threat is still spreading actively, broad changes should not be made without a rollback plan.
items.notes: unless 引出例外条件；without 表示必要保障缺失。

items.zh: 取证镜像的哈希值在采集前后保持一致，从而证明副本没有在传输中改变。
items.en: The forensic image had the same hash before and after collection, demonstrating that the copy was not altered in transit.
answers: The forensic image had the same hash before and after collection, demonstrating that the copy was not altered in transit.
items.notes: demonstrating 作结果补充；in transit 表示传输过程中。

items.zh: 每次证据移交都必须记录时间、交付人、接收人和保管目的。
items.en: Every transfer of evidence must record the time, the person releasing it, the recipient, and the purpose of custody.
answers: Every transfer of evidence must record the time, the person releasing it, the recipient, and the purpose of custody.
items.notes: 多个并列宾语构成保管链记录要求；purpose of custody 指保管目的。

items.zh: 系统时间比标准时间慢了十一分钟，因此时间线已按可验证的偏差校正。
items.en: The system clock was eleven minutes behind the reference time, so the timeline was adjusted for the verified offset.
answers: The system clock was eleven minutes behind the reference time, so the timeline was adjusted for the verified offset.
items.notes: be behind 表示时间落后；adjust for 表示按偏差校正。

items.zh: 我们保留了原始日志，并在工作副本上进行解析，以免破坏原始证据。
items.en: We preserved the original logs and performed the analysis on working copies to avoid modifying the source evidence.
answers: We preserved the original logs and performed the analysis on working copies to avoid modifying the source evidence.
items.notes: perform analysis on 表示基于某材料分析；to avoid doing 表目的。

items.zh: 由于磁盘采用全盘加密，关机可能使当前解密状态和易失数据同时丢失。
items.en: Because the disk uses full-volume encryption, shutting the device down could remove access to both its decrypted state and volatile data.
answers: Because the disk uses full-volume encryption, shutting the device down could remove access to both its decrypted state and volatile data.
items.notes: because 解释现场决策背景；both ... and 并列两类可能损失。

items.zh: 时间线表明凭据在首次恶意登录前三天就已从另一台终端被窃取。
items.en: The timeline indicates that the credentials were stolen from another endpoint three days before the first malicious login.
answers: The timeline indicates that the credentials were stolen from another endpoint three days before the first malicious login.
items.notes: indicate that 转述时间线结论；before 明确事件先后。

items.zh: 注册表项证明程序曾被设置为自动启动，却不能证明它成功执行过。
items.en: The registry entry shows that the program was configured to start automatically, but it does not prove that the program executed successfully.
answers: The registry entry shows that the program was configured to start automatically, but it does not prove that the program executed successfully.
items.notes: show that 与 does not prove that 区分配置证据和执行证据。

items.zh: 多个日志源使用同一会话标识符，使我们能够把身份验证与后续数据访问关联起来。
items.en: A shared session identifier across several log sources enabled us to correlate the authentication with the subsequent data access.
answers: A shared session identifier across several log sources enabled us to correlate the authentication with the subsequent data access.
items.notes: enable someone to do 表示促成能力；correlate A with B 是分析搭配。

items.zh: 浏览器历史记录只能说明页面被访问，不能确定当时坐在设备前的是谁。
items.en: Browser history can establish that a page was visited, but it cannot determine who was operating the device at the time.
answers: Browser history can establish that a page was visited, but it cannot determine who was operating the device at the time.
items.notes: can establish ... but cannot determine 限定数字证据的归因能力。

items.zh: 没有发现文件的原始名称，因为恶意程序在写入磁盘前已经在内存中解码了内容。
items.en: The original filename could not be recovered because the malware decoded the content in memory before writing it to disk.
answers: The original filename could not be recovered because the malware decoded the content in memory before writing it to disk.
items.notes: could not be recovered 是审慎被动；before doing 表示处理顺序。

items.zh: 恢复工作从已知干净的镜像开始，而不是尝试修复完整性未知的系统。
items.en: Recovery began from a known-clean image rather than attempting to repair a system of uncertain integrity.
answers: Recovery began from a known-clean image rather than attempting to repair a system of uncertain integrity.
items.notes: known-clean 是取证和恢复常用复合形容词；rather than doing 对比恢复策略。

items.zh: 业务服务恢复后，增强监控至少保留两周，以发现可能残留的活动。
items.en: After the business service is restored, enhanced monitoring will remain in place for at least two weeks to detect possible residual activity.
answers: After the business service is restored, enhanced monitoring will remain in place for at least two weeks to detect possible residual activity.
items.notes: remain in place 表示持续生效；to detect 说明延长监控目的。

items.zh: 在重新接入网络前，每台受影响终端都要通过补丁、凭据和安全配置检查。
items.en: Before reconnection, every affected endpoint must pass checks on patching, credentials, and security configuration.
answers: Before reconnection, every affected endpoint must pass checks on patching, credentials, and security configuration.
items.notes: before reconnection 给出恢复门槛；checks on 表示针对多项内容的检查。

items.zh: 虽然核心功能已经恢复，积压交易仍需处理，因此业务影响尚未完全结束。
items.en: Although core functionality has been restored, the business impact is not yet over because the transaction backlog still has to be processed.
answers: Although core functionality has been restored, the business impact is not yet over because the transaction backlog still has to be processed.
items.notes: although 引出已恢复部分；because 解释影响仍持续的原因。

items.zh: 若恢复点早于入侵时间，团队仍需确认备份中没有被窃取的凭据。
items.en: Even if the recovery point predates the intrusion, the team must still confirm that the backup contains no compromised credentials.
answers: Even if the recovery point predates the intrusion, the team must still confirm that the backup contains no compromised credentials.
items.notes: even if 引导让步；predate 表示早于。

items.zh: 对外通报只陈述已经核实的事实，并把仍在调查的问题明确标记出来。
items.en: External communications state only verified facts and clearly identify matters that remain under investigation.
answers: External communications state only verified facts and clearly identify matters that remain under investigation.
items.notes: only 限定陈述范围；remain under investigation 是正式通报表达。

items.zh: 初步通知说明的是可能受影响的数据范围，不应被解读为最终泄露数量。
items.en: The initial notification describes the data that may have been affected and should not be interpreted as the final volume of exposure.
answers: The initial notification describes the data that may have been affected and should not be interpreted as the final volume of exposure.
items.notes: may have been affected 表过去可能；should not be interpreted as 防止误读。

items.zh: 监管报告期限从组织意识到可能的违规时开始，而不一定从攻击发生时开始。
items.en: The regulatory reporting period begins when the organisation becomes aware of a possible breach, not necessarily when the attack occurred.
answers: The regulatory reporting period begins when the organisation becomes aware of a possible breach, not necessarily when the attack occurred.
items.notes: become aware of 是固定搭配；not necessarily 区分两个时间起点。

items.zh: 复盘的目的不是追究个人责任，而是找出哪些条件使事件得以发生和扩大。
items.en: The purpose of the review is not to assign individual blame, but to identify the conditions that allowed the incident to occur and escalate.
answers: The purpose of the review is not to assign individual blame, but to identify the conditions that allowed the incident to occur and escalate.
items.notes: not to A but to B 表示复盘目的；allow A to do 是固定结构。

items.zh: 每项经验教训都应转化为有负责人、截止日期和验证方法的改进行动。
items.en: Each lesson learned should become an improvement action with an owner, a deadline, and a method of validation.
answers: Each lesson learned should become an improvement action with an owner, a deadline, and a method of validation.
items.notes: with 引出行动项的三个必要属性；lesson learned 是复盘常用语。
